About

Hi, my name is Robin Dueck Degen, I am an honours student in mathematics at the University of Saskatchewan in my final year. I am particularly interested in Lie theory, and I am currently working on my honors thesis which covers twisting theory for Lie algebras. I am currently applying to MSc programs for Fall 2027. If you are interested in contacting me you can find my University of Saskatchewan email in the sidebar to the right.
